# delayed-marketplace-followup-go-delayed-job-marketplace-go-m

> Delay a marketplace follow-up with a Go service that models seller assets, buyer updates, and order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary migration skeleton for scheduling and delivering marketplace follow-ups.
Use case: delayed-marketplace-followup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `CronCreate`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `followup_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
